summary.text: Carolyn Bosn is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 25, serving since April 7, 2023, when she was appointed to replace Suzanne Geist, who resigned; she was elected in 2024. Her committee assignments are Judiciary, Transportation and Telecommunications, and Committee on Committees.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Bosn was born Carolyn Heide Curry on October 5, 1982, in Columbus and graduated from Columbus High School in 2001.
She earned a B.S. from Baylor University in 2005 and a J.D. from the Creighton University School of Law in 2009.

Her biography lists her occupation as attorney, with past work as a deputy county attorney in the Lancaster County and Saunders County Attorney's Offices and as an adjunct professor and trial team assistant coach at the University of Nebraska College of Law.
It lists her as married to Reginald Bosn since May 8, 2010, with four children.
